[[File:Keshiri_waterworks.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Keshiri waterworks]]
'''Waterworks''' were a form of public infrastructure used to provide water within urban centers. They were found on various planets including [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] had developed these irrigation systems prior to the arrival of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. During the [[Time of the Rot]], many of these waterworks had broken down due to neglect and war damage. By [[2974 BBY]], these waterworks had been rebuilt. During the [[Siege of Tahv]] in 2974 BBY, [[Parlan Spinner]] accidentally damaged a portion of the waterworks while piloting an ancient [[Last Hope (Jedi starship)|Jedi starship]], which had been hidden under the [[Circle Eternal]] for millennia.
